content: For fasting blood glucose and lipid panel tests, fast for 8 to 12 hours prior to your appointment. Water is allowed. Avoid strenuous exercise immediately before the test.
Fast for 6 hours prior to the procedure. You may drink clear water up to 2 hours before. Avoid carbonated beverages and milk.

Apex AI Arabia Healthcare complies with Council of Health Insurance (CCHI) regulations. Coverage depends on your network tier (VIP, A, B). Copayments usually range from 0% to 20% capped at SAR 100 per visit according to unified policy terms.

Routine outpatient consultations do not require pre-approval. Specialized imaging (MRI/CT), non-emergency surgical procedures, and brand-name medications require insurer pre-authorization, which takes 24 to 48 hours.
Main clinic branches in Riyadh and Jeddah operate Sunday through Thursday, 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and Saturdays 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Closed on Fridays.
